threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think ‘cabbies’ means black cabs, not the ones with the terrifying randoms on the way to the station.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Peckham last weekend. A guy singing Old School garage at the top of his lungs, and no one even blinked. Just another Saturday!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw an old man feeding pigeons while a street artist painted a mural in the background. It’s the little contrasts that capture you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see bus drivers hopping off to grab a coffee while passengers wait. It's like they know we all have places to be, but coffee first!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know the exact moment to hop off BART before the Civic Center chaos kicks in—yesterday was a real test!

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a kid on the 19 Polk dancing with a sandwich in one hand, spreading joy like butter. Classic Tenderloin moment, never a dull ride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about the parks and quaint streets, but they miss the local bars bursting with energy at 3 AM. That's real Gràcia.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still ask for 'tapas' like it’s a menu item rather than just a way of life here.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still don’t know the ‘shortcut’ through the market that actually adds 10 minutes to your journey. The locals glide right by it.
Caught the N35 last night and a bloke was serenading the driver with opera. Turned the whole bus into a mini concert—very Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was living in Neukölln when I saw a group of kids doing a dance-off in the street while the bus driver honked, totally unfazed.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin does a bus strike turn into a spontaneous street party—everyone embracing the chaos with drinks in hand on the sidewalks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s truly from the Mission if they can name three taco spots that survived the last rent hike. No tourist would bother.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy pull out a saxophone on the 19 Polk and start a mini concert. Everyone just vibed. Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve vermut on tap like it's the norm, but most locals prefer it bottled and only during proper hours.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they flinch at the noise of the castellers—locals just cheer them on without a second thought.
